trials.claim: Includes all future Individual, Business Plus or Agency plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Individual (Tier 1), Business Plus (Tier 2) or Agency (Tier 3-4) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: E1 only says an update wiped Loco Translate translations; it does not show whether future Individual, Business Plus, or Agency plan updates were included or withheld.

exhibits.quote: after the 1st update I noticed that all my translations had been gone which I created with Loco Translate.
exhibits.argument: Future updates wiped out user translations, undermining the value of promised future plan updates.

trials.claim: Offers SCORM-ready courses with bundles, memberships, certificates and gamification
trials.claimQuote: Build SCORM-ready courses, sell bundles and memberships, and engage learners with certificates and gamification
trials.reasoning: E2 says SCORM add-ons required buying the LMS again monthly, annually, or via another lifetime deal, directly conflicting with SCORM being included, despite E5 praising the certificate builder.

exhibits.quote: After purchasing the Lifetime Deal via AppSumo when accessing the add-ons to install the SCORM functionality it requires you to buy the LMS AGAIN either paying monthly, annually, or buy another lifetime deal on their website.
exhibits.argument: SCORM functionality is not included in the lifetime deal and requires a separate paid purchase.

exhibits.quote: The interface is user-friendly, and the features, especially the Q&A system and the certificate builder, are fantastic.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the certificate builder feature works and is fantastic.

trials.claim: Can generate courses with AI or build from YouTube content
trials.claimQuote: Generate courses with AI, or build one instantly from YouTube content
trials.reasoning: E3 reports a lack of AI features, directly conflicting with the claim that courses can be generated with AI.

exhibits.quote: Overall, the lack of AI features and slow processing makes Academy LMS feel outdated and inefficient.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports a lack of AI features, contradicting the AI course generation claim.

trials.claim: Provides multi-step builder with import/export of lessons and quizzes
trials.claimQuote: Structure lessons, chapters, quizzes, and assignments in a multi-step builder, and import or export lessons and quizzes
trials.reasoning: E4 complains about a theme import button, not importing or exporting lessons and quizzes, so it neither confirms nor contradicts the claimed lesson and quiz import/export.

exhibits.quote: Even after upgrading to Pro and purchasing additional tools, the import button for themes still didn’t work as expected.
exhibits.argument: Import functionality did not work even after upgrading, undermining the import/export claim.

trials.claim: Allows upgrading between 4 license tiers while deal is available
trials.claimQuote: Ability to upgrade between 4 license tiers while the deal is available
trials.reasoning: Two buyers confirm upgrading tiers, with E6 upgrading to tier 4 and E7 upgrading to the 3rd tier, and no exhibit undercuts this.

exhibits.quote: I have recently upgraded to tier4 to support this team.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms they were able to upgrade to a higher license tier.

exhibits.quote: I upgraded to the 3rd tier as I see great potential in this plugin.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms upgrading between license tiers is possible.
